# Frostline (FLI)
> **Experimental, not security-hardened — see SECURITY.md.** Not production ready; no marketplace di
stribution (dev-script install only).
Frostline is a project knowledge graph inspired by GRACE Marketplace, implementing an architectural
knowledge graph with automatic context delivery to AI agents.
When reading a file, an agent receives the contracts of its architectural ancestors before the file'
s own content. This allows the autoregressive model to interpret the code with prior knowledge of it
s purpose, requirements, and architectural context.
In its current implementation, Frostline focuses exclusively on architectural knowledge management,
without mechanisms for managing agents, tasks, or development workflows.

Nodes are XML contracts, stored by default in `.frostline/graph/`.
**The principle is knowledge inheritance without duplication.** As the graph is traversed upward, de
tail decreases while architectural scope expands: from an individual module to the project as a whol
il decreases while architectural scope expands: from an individual module to the project as a whole.
This gives the agent a holistic understanding of the system, its components, and their relationships
, making codebase navigation easier.
Frostline recursively collects the ancestors of a read file and automatically delivers them to the a
gent. Documents already delivered are not injected again.
**The mechanism is deterministic:** no LLM inference or semantic search. The source of truth is the
filesystem and explicit relationships.
